**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Report the 13-seed subset from the extended runs**

These campaign legs produce overall results for the 18-seed extended fixture and a separate run against the standalone 13-seed snapshot, but they never require per-run recall/variance for the original thirteen within the extended-fixture runs. AC8 requires that subset alongside the extended result in addition to the repeated original-fixture control, because the five added patches share the extended prompt and can change how the model handles the original defects. Derive and report the 13-seed subset from every extended run separately from the standalone control.
